subject: NAVIGATIONAL WARNING TO ALL CONCERNED:
text:
A4874/26 NOTAMN
Q) LTXX/QAFXX/IV/NBO/E /000/999/3822N02559E357
A) LTBB LGGG B) 2611040600 C) 2611041000
E) NAVIGATIONAL WARNING TO ALL CONCERNED:

TURKIYE REQUESTED THE GREEK AIS TO MODIFY THE LIMITS OF THE GREEK 
NOTAM A3956/26 WHICH OVERLAPS TURKISH MILITARY FIRING EXERCISE AREA 
(WARNING NOTAM A2143/26) WITHIN INTERNATIONAL AIRSPACE. GREEK AIS 
DID NOT MODIFY THE SAID AREA, THEREFORE THE GREEK NOTAM A3956/26 IS
NULL AND VOID. TURKISH NAVIGATIONAL WARNING NOTAM A2143/26 IS VALID 
AND EFFECTIVE.
